name: Transfer Funds
description: Signs on, looks up a member, and moves funds between their own checking and savings balances, then confirms the result.

inputParams.name: username
inputParams.description: Operator ID used to sign on to the terminal.

inputParams.name: password
inputParams.description: Operator password used to sign on to the terminal.

inputParams.name: memberId
inputParams.description: The member whose own checking/savings funds to move.

inputParams.name: fromAccount
inputParams.description: Which of the member's own accounts to move funds out of: Checking or Savings.

inputParams.name: toAccount
inputParams.description: Which of the member's own accounts to move funds into: Checking or Savings.

inputParams.name: amount
inputParams.description: Dollar amount to transfer. Plain numeric value, no currency symbol.

detector.expr: must be a valid, positive number
